message: `{op}` is not part of Verilog-A: Annex C excludes the case-equality operators, which compare four-state logic values (`x`, `z`) that an analog value cannot hold; use `{instead}`
description: `===` and `!==` compare digital values that can be unknown (`x`) or high-impedance (`z`). Verilog-A values are real numbers, so the language excludes these operators.
